name: Breath Counting
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Sit comfortably with your eyes closed or your gaze softened, and let your breathing settle into its natural rhythm.
Silently count "one" as you exhale, then "two" on the next exhale, continuing up to "ten".
Once you reach ten, start again from "one" — you're only counting the exhale, not the inhale.
Whenever you notice your mind has wandered or you've lost count, simply start again from "one" without judgment.
Continue this cycle for 5-10 minutes, treating every restart as part of the practice, not a failure of it.
